reviews.title: HP OmniBook Ultra 14 - Works Great for Me!!!!
reviews.body: I bought this device to replace a Dell laptop that was beginning to have issues with managing Zoom meetings at the same time I had other applications open to support what was happening in the Zoom meeting.  The OmniBook solved that for me and the issues I was having before are not happening anymore.
